stem: A technician finishes work in a room with a known pest issue and is next assigned to a clean propagation area. What is the best approach?
choices: Move to propagation after changing gloves, while carrying the same tools and outer clothing used in the affected room
Follow the facility's decontamination and tool-change procedure before entering the cleaner propagation area
Remove visible debris from tools and proceed, then inspect the propagation area later for signs that contamination occurred
Enter propagation before completing decontamination when no pests are visible on clothing, then sanitize at the end of the shift
rationale: People, tools, and clothing can move pests or pathogens between areas. Controlled movement and defined decontamination procedures reduce transfer from higher-risk rooms into cleaner propagation spaces.
